Gamma · Enhanced understanding

Improve question matching with a small local language-understanding model. Experimental; it retrieves guidance and does not generate answers.

MiniLM quantized weights: 22,972,370 bytes (21.9 MiB), plus tokenizer and 20.6 MiB of runtime assets. Downloads contact Hugging Face. Processing stays local. CPU/WASM; no WebGPU required.

Gamma · Deep Mode

Experimental local drafts from built-in evidence or selected documents. Use /deep followed by a supported topic, or /deep summarize documents. Quotations are checked; generated explanations can still be wrong.

HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-360M-Instruct, Apache-2.0. Quantized weights: 364,564,671 bytes (347.7 MiB), plus tokenizer and runtime assets. Downloads contact Hugging Face. CPU/WASM; allow substantial memory and setup time. No conversations are uploaded. Core remains available without this model.

Offline & installation

After a successful cached visit, Gamma works offline. Use your browser’s Install or Add to Home Screen control where supported. For the Chromium extension, download the build artifact from GitHub Actions and load its extracted folder through the extension manager.
